_comment: HAND-BUILT, not captured. The shape is probe 24's, measured against a live project; every
VALUE here is invented. Real audit rows carry another team's edits - who changed what, from
what, to what - and those never enter this repository (CLAUDE.md hard constraint). A shape is
schema and is safe to record; the rows are not.
It exercises all four forms probe 24 found in the wild, because a parser that handles only the
first is wrong for the majority of real records:
entry 1 - Property is an ARRAY   (129 of 678 entries)
entry 2 - Property is an OBJECT  (464 of 678 - the COMMON case)
entry 3 - Properties absent      (85 of 678 - a change with nothing recorded about it)
and audits-shape-single.json covers Audit itself collapsing to an object (4 of 119 records).
